title: AIML Annual AI Hackathon 2026 Registration Open
content: Registration is open for the AIML Department Annual Hackathon: Generative AI and Autonomous Systems. Inter-department teams permitted. Prize pool of $5000 and GPU compute credits provided.

title: AIML Semester Exams & Lab Assessment Schedule
content: Mid-semester theory examinations and laboratory practical evaluations for AIML batches (AIML-A and AIML-B) will commence on April 18th. Detailed seating plans posted on notice board.

title: High Performance AI Lab Server Maintenance
content: GPU cluster in Lab 401 (AIML Block) will undergo scheduled hypervisor and driver upgrades on Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM. Save training checkpoints before maintenance window.

title: Guest Lecture on Multimodal Foundation Models
content: Distinguished Industry Speaker session on 'Scaling Multimodal Vision-Language Models in Production' on Wednesday at 2:30 PM in Seminar Hall 2.

title: Hostel & Campus Facilities Maintenance
content: Block A and Student Center will undergo water pipeline maintenance from 10 AM to 3 PM on March 28th.
